Combining these could help identify strong support/resistance areas with confirmation from momentum.

I also need to include stop-loss and take-profit levels. Using ATR makes sense here because it adapts to changing volatility. Maybe setting the stop-loss at 1.5*ATR below support for longs and above resistance for shorts. Take-profit at 2*ATR.
